title: Still a slow & sluggish app
body:
Feb 2019:
Another update but once again no speed improvement and now includes some new functionality & design features that HAVE NOT been thought out properly!

New functionality is the Card Control settings. Very good!

However, the poorly thought out design is that the Card Control feature seems to always be open by default, with the first option within those settings to be “Temporary Block”.

When going to close the Card Control area the close button is right above the “Temporary Block” toggle which is annoying to accidentally invoke a “temporary block” each time you close the Card Control options.

Still no inclusion of the Touchpoints Account.

 

Jan 2019:

Im sure some effort has gone into trying to speed up this app, but it is still frustratingly slow, and sluggish.

UNABLE to use the “TouchPoints” account for payments just adds more frustration and dissatisfaction.

I’ll wait for one more incremental upgrade and if the speed issues and Touchpoints are not addressed, then its time to move to a new Bank. There are significantly better offerings in the market right now!
Even a one star is one too many for this app.
A big 👎🏻
